# Wandee Asian Fusion

> Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. A small, beautifully decorated room with a long menu and plenty of vegetarian choices.

- Address: 5915 Memorial Hwy #101, Tampa, FL 33615
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country, Gibsonton
- Offers: Noodles and rice; Duck, pork and seafood; Vegetarian and drinks
